sources.snippet: FourCastNet3 (FCN3) is the latest AI global weather forecasting system from NVIDIA Earth-2. FCN3 offers an unprecedented combination of probabilistic skill, computational efficiency, spectral fidelity, ensemble calibration, and stability at subseasonal timescales.
